description: Discover the best hotels in Noosa, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Chic Noosa Escape on Hastings Street with Outdoor Pool, Spa & Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Nestled in the heart of Noosa on iconic Hastings Street, this luxurious stay offers a blend of coastal charm and sophisticated elegance. Elysium Noosa Resort - MGallery Collection invites you to unwind with a meal at Noosa Beach House Restaurant, sip a spritz at the Riviera Bar & Lounge while watching the sunset over the Noosa River, or relax by the lagoon-style pool with a swim-up bar. Venture out to explore boutiques and local eateries along Hastings Street, or take a leisurely river cruise. For food lovers, the Noosa Farmers Market is a must-visit, offering fresh local produce and artisanal treats. This resort is the perfect base to experience the natural beauty and vibrant lifestyle of one of Australia’s most sought-after beach destinations.

hotels.title: Stylish Noosa Apartment Escape on Hastings Street
hotels.description: Discover the magic of the Sunshine Coast with a stay at Jacaranda Noosa Apartments, perfectly positioned in its most iconic shopping precinct and offering unrivalled access to the region's spectacular surf beaches, charming coastal towns and sprawling wilderness. Between moments spent by the resort’s outdoor pool, wave to the dolphins at Noosa National Park or savour sunset cocktails and Laguna Bay views on Hastings Street, surrounded by fairy lights.

hotels.title: Noosa Apartment-Style Escape with Daily Breakfast & Daily $50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Find serenity on the Sunshine Coast and embrace the laid-back lifestyle of Noosa at this five-star modern resort. Surrounded by lush bushland, this is the perfect private escape mere moments from Noosa's best - with spacious apartments offering the ideal space to stretch out after a day of exploration. Begin your day with a bountiful breakfast at Arcuri, sip on a refreshing drink at Dazza’s Bar or indulge in a signature treatment at One Spa, where relaxation is redefined. The lagoon pool and infinity-edge heated pool are ideal for a touch of zen; for families, the splash park, water slides and games room keep everyone entertained. Whether you're enjoying a casual meal by the pool, taking the complimentary shuttle to Hastings Street or perfecting your backhand on the tennis court, every moment feels like a personalised slice of paradise.

hotels.title: Modern Noosa Apartment Stay on Hastings Street Close to Noosa Main Beach
hotels.description: Experience quintessential Sunshine Coast bliss at The Sebel Noosa, nestled in the heart of Hastings Street. This stylish home-away-from-home is a stone's throw from Noosa's Main Beach and the tranquil waters of the Noosa River. Indulge at local eateries, explore the boutique shops of Hastings Street, hike in the hinterlands and enjoy endless fun in the sun. Back at the resort, stretch out in your spacious apartment or take a dip in the sparkling pool.
